Record payment(s)

Enter a member's REF number and the amount they paid. If they're owing on their last claim, the payment settles that first — the remainder tops up Upfront Plus.
Mary Handina — balance R160.00
Paste a list of payments, one per line — REF number and amount, in any order or format ("97 110", "98,250", "99: R90" all work, including pasting straight from a spreadsheet). Each line settles that member's claim owing first, then tops up Upfront Plus with the remainder — exactly like a single payment, just all at once.

Pay for someone else

A member pays on behalf of another member, using their own Upfront Plus balance. The payer's balance is reduced by the amount, and the beneficiary is credited with the same settle-claim-owing-first logic as a normal payment. Both members are looked up by REF.

Meeting fee — deduct or deposit

For members covering a meeting fee. Deduct from Upfront Plus takes the fee straight out of their existing balance (their balance must cover it). Record a deposit is for members topping up with cash specifically to cover the meeting — it's added straight to Upfront Plus, no claim-owing offset. Either way, Meetings Paid/Owed on their current claim updates automatically: an owed meeting is cleared first, otherwise Meetings Paid goes up by one.
A member covers another member's meeting fee using their own Upfront Plus balance. The payer's balance is reduced by the amount; the beneficiary's balance is untouched — they just get the meeting credited (owed meeting cleared first, otherwise Meetings Paid goes up by one).

Corrections

Look up a member and correct their record directly — Upfront Plus balance and claim owing amount. This overrides whatever the payment logic produced and is logged separately from real transactions. For dependents, meetings, or individual claim edits, use "Open full record" below.
Paste a list of fixes, one per line — REF number, then a new balance and/or claim owing amount. This overwrites whatever's currently on file for that member, exactly like a single correction, just many at once. Formats accepted per line: REF, then a plain number for the new Upfront Plus balance, and/or owing=NN for the claim owing amount. Mix and match, separated by spaces or commas.

Example: 97 owing=0 350 sets Ref 97's balance to R350 and claim owing to R0. 3, owing=50 only changes Ref 3's claim owing amount.

Add or replace a member

When a member passes away or defaults and someone else is taking over their slot, use "Replace" — it keeps the same REF number and payment history running under the new name. When it's a brand-new person joining the club, use "Add new member" to give them their own REF.
Assign a REF number for the new member — pick the next one after the highest REF currently in the register, or any REF that's free.

Nobody is owing on their last claim, and everybody is at or above the R160 Upfront Plus minimum. 🎉

Active claims

Claim 72 is the current active claim — every member is either paid up or owing on it right now, same as how TRBC manages its own current claim. Older claim numbers still sitting on individual member records (visible in "Open full record") are history only — a record of how many funeral levies each member has paid since joining, which naturally differs since members joined Makwenyembani at different times. They don't affect who's covered here. Set the deduction amount below (funeral levy amounts vary — R160, R110, R60 — so there's no single default) and "Apply to all N members" runs it against every active member: anyone with enough Upfront Plus balance is deducted; anyone short has their balance taken to R0 and the shortfall added to their claim owing amount instead. From then on, any payment that member makes is applied automatically in order — lapse penalty first (if liable), then claim owing, then whatever's left tops up Upfront Plus — so shortfalls catch up on their own as the member keeps paying, no manual step needed.

No claim currently open Claim 73 lapsed

Claim 73 is closed and done — its column is off the register, and members still owing on it carry a R50 lapse penalty (see below). Open the next claim to resume tracking.

Lapse penalties 0 liable

Members still liable: 0 Outstanding penalty total: R0.00 Collected to group fund: R0.00
R50 per member is skimmed automatically off their next deposit (before claim owing/Upfront Plus) and added to the group fund. Nothing to do manually here.

Move to a new claim

Once Claim 72 is fully settled and a new funeral levy round opens, use this to switch the current active claim (e.g. to 73). This only changes which claim number the register and claim management track going forward — it does not touch anyone's balance.

Export final register

Builds the printable register from the current live data: REF — Name & Surname — Upfront — Claim 72. Claim 71 is left off since every member has already paid it; the Claim 72 column is shaded green when a member has caught up on it, blank if still owing. Upfront prints in red when below R160 (R160 and above print in black).
